releaseNotes: APK fix: rebuilt with the correct app domain (realsonora.base44.app) — resolves the 'App not found' error on Android
APK fix: in-app APK installer now correctly registers FileProvider so updates install without a browser redirect
Critical fix: Electron no longer shows a false 'You're offline' screen on cold start — transient load failures now retry with backoff, and the offline screen continuously auto-reconnects
Exact-version playback: when a song isn't playable in your region, Sonora now only plays the identical recording by the same artist — never a cover, DJ edit, remix or a different song
Alternate versions always stream in the highest available quality
Deeper search across SoundCloud and Audius to find a playable copy of more songs
New sleep timer in Audio Controls (5 to 90 minutes)
New keyboard shortcuts: Up/Down for volume, M to mute, S for shuffle, R for repeat
